mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in real GDP signals a strong economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following positive GDP growth, or GDP growth explains less than 10% of SPX return variation (R^2 < 0.10) in a rolling 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate signals a rapidly weakening economy that will pressure corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 0.5pp+ rise in UNRATE, or UNRATE explains less than 5% of SPX return variation (R^2 < 0.05) in a rolling 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating rise in industrial production signals strengthening economic momentum that will boost equity valuations and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following accelerating INDPRO growth, or INDPRO growth explains less than 10% of SPX return variation (R^2 < 0.10) in a rolling 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts signals a weakening consumer sector that will pressure economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 10%+ YoY drop in HOUST, or HOUST explains less than 5% of SPX return variation (R^2 < 0.05) in a rolling 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy that will pressure equity valuations and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 0.5pp+ rise in FEDFUNDS, or FEDFUNDS explains less than 5% of SPX return variation (R^2 < 0.05) in a rolling 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating decline in the unemployment rate signals a tightening labor market that will boost wage growth and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following accelerating UNRATE declines, or UNRATE explains less than 10% of SPX return variation (R^2 < 0.10) in a rolling 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in consumer prices signals rising inflationary pressures that will erode consumer purchasing power and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 0.5pp+ rise in CPIAUCSL, or CPIAUCSL explains less than 5% of SPX return variation (R^2 < 0.05) in a rolling 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production signals a weakening industrial sector that will pressure economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 5%+ YoY drop in INDPRO, or INDPRO explains less than 5% of SPX return variation (R^2 < 0.05) in a rolling 3-year window.
